recommendation_summary: Keep nightly-sync on edna, add a heartbeat ping on success to a self-hosted Healthchecks container on the Synology, and have it alert by email or push when a ping is late or fails.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to know within a day if nightly-sync fails without reading logs. You suggested a central log on the Synology and Dockerizing everything.
labels.Deleted: Central log collection, log dashboard, Dockerizing nightly-sync.
labels.Bottleneck: You only learn by absence of an email, so a silent crash waits 4 days until you go looking.
labels.Checked myself: I only know what you told me: cron on edna at 03:00, emails only on success, 4 startup crashes on expired token with no email, no other alerting.

note: The reply turns down central logging, but it still recommends a self-hosted Healthchecks Docker container on the Synology, so it counts as LARGER.
